scope: A 105-scene subset of MIT-Adobe FiveK default-ISP and photographer-fit renders; this is not the full FiveK dataset.

source_fit_run.fit_objective: sRGB-display smooth-L1 pixel loss + 0.25 low-frequency loss + 0.002 normalized-control L2 regularization; best of three palette starts

annotation_provenance.underlying_model_identifier: Not exposed in the original annotation session metadata.
annotation_provenance.user_reported_model_label: GPT-5.6 Luna; visible in a user-provided screenshot labeling a report-verification execution, not independently confirmed for the original annotation turns.
annotation_provenance.annotation_mode: Assistant-authored visual review; not human ground truth or consensus labels.
annotation_provenance.per_image_prompt: No fixed per-image prompt was recorded. The stored guidance is reconstructed from the interaction instructions.
annotation_provenance.batch_vlm: No batch vision-language model generated the committed fit descriptions. A Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct pilot was rejected after reversing a known brightness difference and missing warmth.

components.target: Describe each fitted ISP render relative to Default ISP. Expert TIFF previews were visible as context, so this was not blinded.

components.method: Short, assistant-authored style labels; not actual Instagram presets or verified filter equivalences.
Image-specific visual resemblance estimates only; no named preset was applied or verified as an equivalent.

components.target: Separate assistant-authored annotations comparing Expert TIFF previews with Default ISP; these are not the fitted-render descriptions.

display_resolution.sharpness_caveat: Annotations were authored from reduced comparison-sheet previews, not full-resolution crops; they do not provide a reliable sharpness assessment.

source_assets_note: RAW/DNG files, photographer TIFFs, and fit renders remain outside this repository. Do not redistribute them without confirming applicable license and dataset terms.
